findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因子：客戶可能自行開發或收購與本公司產品類似或可替代的元件／技術，對業務與經營結果構成重大不利影響；未列出特定新興替代技術。
findings.excerpt: Customers may continue to increase their use of internally developed components. They may also decide to develop or acquire components, technologies or products that are similar to, or that may be substituted for, our products, or acquire companies that compete with us.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 Item 1：公司預期現有競爭者及新進者持續競爭，不保證產品持續具競爭力。
findings.excerpt: However, there is no assurance that our products will continue to compete favorably or that we will be successful in the face of increasing competition from new products introduced by existing competitors or new companies entering our markets.

findings.claim: Nasdaq 文章（2026-02）稱 800V DC 資料中心架構為 MPWR 的大機會（非替代威脅）
findings.source: Nasdaq: Monolithic Power Systems surging, has valuation caught up

note: 搜尋未找到具名的替代技術（如垂直供電、800V HVDC、GaN）取代MPWR核心產品的來源；搜尋摘要顯示800V資料中心架構被描述為成長機會而非威脅，但無可逐字原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
